scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:background && npm run build:content && npm run build:popup && npm run build:options
scripts.build:content: vite build -c vite.config.content.ts --mode spoof-main && vite build -c vite.config.content.ts --mode spoof-bridge
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f nomada-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qrX ../nomada-extension.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && rm -f nomada-firefox.zip nomada-firefox-source.zip && (cd dist-firefox && zip -qrX ../nomada-firefox.zip .) && git archive --format=zip -o nomada-firefox-source.zip HEAD
